semantics.consent: Every routine or security event is accepted only when consent is explicitly granted. Security failures never bypass consent.
semantics.correlation: The server resolves its internal publication ID from the claimed brand, platform, rollout channel, activation version, config version, and SHA-256. That complete tuple must match the succeeded currently-live publication; clients never send the internal ID.
semantics.idempotency: clientEventId is globally unique. An exact replay by the same authenticated principal is accepted with duplicate=true; reuse for different data is rejected.
semantics.eventTime: Client event time is required and bounded, but promotion windows use authenticated server receipt time.
semantics.aggregation: The eligible sample is a distinct authenticated principal reporting any accepted event for the exact publication in the observation window. Each numerator is the distinct subset reporting that outcome, so repeated rows cannot increase a rate.
semantics.privacy: Do not send a device fingerprint, payload value, email, configuration content, secret, or free-form exception text. Unknown fields are rejected.
semantics.retention: Accepted event rows are immutable. Scheduled maintenance deletes rows after the 90-day retention window; authenticated account erasure may delete that principal's rows earlier.
